snippet.title: Bro's scaled his app to $25K MRR with this 1 content strategy
snippet.description:
Kyan is 21, still in college, and his first app (ToneAdapt) is doing $25K/month after 5 months.

His content playbook:

Post 3x a day across IG, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook

Put your face on it from day one

Wait for ONE format to convert

Hire UGC creators to remake that exact format 60x a month

Pour Meta + TikTok ad spend behind it

Ride the winner until it dies, then find the next one

That’s the entire formula. Most people quit before they ever find the winner.
